text: In November 2007, some parents challenged Jodi Picoult's The Tenth Circle at Westhampton Beach High School, New York, objecting to its sexual content and requested its removal from the ninth-grade optional reading list. In December 2007, the Westhampton Beach school board banned the book and removed it from the ninth-grade reading list, after parents objected to what they deemed inappropriate sexual content.
